# Intropy.Topology

A small .NET library providing an **in-memory model and fluent builder** for an
Intropy system topology (systems, their component blocks, infrastructure
resources, and the data-flow edges between them).

## Scope — read this first

This library is **model + builder only**. It does **not** serialize, write files,
or emit `topology.json` — the JSON emission layer was deliberately removed and
now lives elsewhere (the Go side / dashboard tooling). Do **not** reintroduce
`System.Text.Json`, `ToJson`/`Save`, serialization attributes
(`[JsonPropertyName]`, `[JsonStringEnumMemberName]`), or a `SchemaVersion` here
without an explicit request — keeping the model serialization-agnostic is the
point.

## Layout

- `src/Intropy.Topology/` — the library (`net10.0`)
  - `Models/` — plain data types: `SystemTopology` (root), `Component`,
    `Resource`, `Edge`, `Trigger`, `Generator`, and the `ComponentType` /
    `ResourceType` / `EdgeKind` / `TriggerKind` enums. `Ref` (internal) builds
    the `component:<name>` / `resource:<name>` reference strings edges use.
  - `Building/` — `SystemBuilder` (entry point) and `ComponentBuilder` (fluent
    per-component wiring).
- `tests/Intropy.Topology.Tests/` — xUnit tests.
- `Intropy.Topology.slnx` — the solution.

## Build & test

```sh
dotnet build Intropy.Topology.slnx
dotnet test Intropy.Topology.slnx
```

The library sets `TreatWarningsAsErrors=true` and `GenerateDocumentationFile=true`,
so warnings (including missing XML doc comments on public members) fail the
build. Public types and members get `///` summaries.

## Authoring a topology

Start from `SystemBuilder.Create`, declare resources and blocks, then wire flow
through the returned `ComponentBuilder`. Authors never hand-type reference
strings — the relationship helpers build the edges.

```csharp
var system = SystemBuilder.Create("product-distribution")
    .WithOwner("group:default/team-integration")
    .InDomain("distribution")
    .GeneratedBy("Intropy.Topology", version: "0.1.0", source: "integrations@3f9c2e1");

var productRaw = system.AddTopic("product-raw", entity: "RawProduct", pubsub: "product-distribution-pubsub");

system.AddExtractor("pim-extractor")
    .WithTags("int-042")
    .InProject("pim-extractor")
    .Workload("cronjob")
    .OnSchedule("*/15 * * * *")
    .Publishes(productRaw);

system.AddLoader("erp-loader")
    .InProject("erp-loader")
    .Consumes(productRaw);

SystemTopology topology = system.Build();
```

Conventions worth preserving:
- Wiring a component to a topic auto-registers that topic on the system (matched
  by name, first declaration wins), so a topic reference can be declared once and
  shared.
- `Publishes` produces a `component → resource` publish edge; `Consumes` produces
  a `resource → component` consume edge.
- Component types are the three edge blocks: `Extractor`, `Loader`,
  `TransactionalIntegration`. `Topic` is the only modeled resource today;
  databases/connectors come later.

## Conventions

- Match the surrounding style: file-scoped namespaces, `sealed` classes,
  collection expressions (`[]`), `required` members where appropriate.
- Tests are xUnit, named `Method_describes_the_behavior`, one behavior per fact.
